name: structured/crlf-line-endings
description: Line endings survive per line, so a CRLF head with an LF body stays mixed, and Content-Length counts the bytes actually sent, CRLF included (30 here, not the 29 an LF-normalised count would give).

steps.input:
POST /n HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: text/plain
Content-Length: 22

mail admin@corp.io
ok

expect.equals:
POST /n HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: text/plain
Content-Length: 30

mail user1@target1.example
ok

POST /n HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: text/plain
Content-Length: 22

mail admin@corp.io
ok

steps.input:
POST /n HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: text/plain

mail admin@corp.io
ok
end
